meta.name: web-search
meta.description: Web search and content extraction with Tavily and Exa via inference.sh CLI. Apps: Tavily Search, Tavily Extract, Exa Search, Exa Answer, Exa Extract. Capabilities: AI-powered search, content extraction, direct answers, research. Use for: research, RAG pipelines, fact-checking, content aggregation, agents. Triggers: web search, tavily, exa, search api, content extraction, research, internet search, ai search, search assistant, web scraping, rag, perplexity alternative

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用AI搜索网页并提取内容
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从互联网获取结构化信息用于分析或RAG。
copy.tagline_en: Search the web and extract content with AI
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to gather structured information from the internet for analysis or RAG.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以通过命令行调用 Tavily 和 Exa 进行网络搜索、内容提取和获取直接答案。它会返回搜索结果、摘要或网页正文。
howto.when: 当你提到“搜索”、“查资料”、“验证事实”等关键词，或要求获取最新信息时触发。

say.text: 帮我搜索2024年AI的最新进展

say.note: 使用 Tavily Extract 提取指定URL的正文。
使用 Exa Answer 直接返回事实性答案。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can perform web searches, content extraction, and get direct answers via Tavily and Exa using the command line. It returns search results, summaries, or page content.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like 'search', 'research', 'fact-check', or ask for up-to-date information.

say_en.text: Search for the latest AI developments in 2024
say_en.note: Uses Tavily Search Assistant to return results with answers.

say_en.text: Extract content from this URL: https://example.com/article
say_en.note: Uses Tavily Extract to get clean text from the URL.

say_en.text: What is the population of Tokyo?
say_en.note: Uses Exa Answer to return a direct factual answer.
